subject: Update PARAMS argument for ft.aggregate documentation (#558)
reason: The change edits only src/commands/ft.aggregate.json, a command-documentation metadata file describing FT.AGGREGATE's PARAMS argument. That file is not compiled into the module (src/commands/CMakeLists.txt lists only .cc sources), is referenced by no source, build, or load path, and the module exposes no command-docs API using it. The built module binary and all runtime behaviour (parsing, replies, indexing) are identical on both builds, so there is nothing a scenario could exercise.
